subject.title: fix(usage): omit costUsd when model pricing is all-zero (unknown)

question: Should OpenClaw treat every all-zero resolved model-pricing configuration as unknown for runtime usage, including models intentionally priced at $0, or should the model-cost contract expose a separate known-free signal?
rationale: The submitted patch aligns runtime behavior with the claimed session-summary guard, but omission versus explicit zero is a compatibility-visible product/accounting semantic that cannot safely be inferred without independently reading the provider and pricing contracts.

options.title: Confirm all-zero means unknown
options.body: Accept the aligned semantics and merge once the owner confirms that intentionally free models have a distinct representation or are also meant to report unknown cost.

options.title: Represent known-free pricing explicitly
options.body: Keep `$0` for explicitly free models by adding a provenance or pricing-known signal rather than using all-zero numeric fields as the only discriminator.

recommendation.title: Confirm all-zero means unknown
recommendation.body: Accept the aligned semantics and merge once the owner confirms that intentionally free models have a distinct representation or are also meant to report unknown cost.
